conviction_note: The findings are small and point both ways, summing to +1.8. Peers and a direct customer (STM guide +10.5% sequential, BorgWarner light-vehicle eProducts +33%), a 52%-of-shares short and calls bid over puts all lean up. Against that, GM's US EV deliveries fell 17% and Lucid's production 38% quarter on quarter during WOLF's fiscal Q1, a 58M-share resale registration sits over any rally, and 3 of the 4 post-emergence prints fell (-18.2, -9.7, +17.6, -9.4). So p_up sits at 51 and the scaled number is near zero. abs_move_pct 14 comes from the 11.75% event-implied move, the 13.7% median post-emergence reaction and a crowded short, and is not shrunk for sign uncertainty. The scaled +0.28 is much smaller than the +1.8 sum because the reaction history and the convert-hedge character of the short interest pull p_up toward 50, not because the findings were shrunk.
bar: Fiscal Q1 2027 (quarter ending about 2026-09-27) revenue $140-160M company guide (8-K ex.99.1, 2026-08-19, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/895419/000089541926000049/ex991q4-26.htm), with non-GAAP gross margin guided negative and non-GAAP opex $62-66M. Consensus revenue $149.86M and EPS -$1.98 (MarketBeat, 2026-10-28, https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/upcoming-wolfspeed-wolf-projected-to-announce-earnings-on-wednesday-2026-10-28/); Benzinga shows $150.0M and about -$2.02 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/WOLF/earnings-forecasts); Susquehanna EPS -$2.39. Two estimate sources agree with the guide midpoint, so the bar is sourced. The stock trades on gross margin, cash burn, the forward guide and any refinancing of the roughly $630M of ~16% first-lien debt, more than on the revenue line.
positioning_check: Short interest 27,376,417 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 51.7% of the 53.0M shares outstanding, 4.25 days to cover on October volume. It has risen at every settlement since August: 24.0M on 08-14, 24.6M on 08-31, 26.1M on 09-15, 26.85M on 09-30 (11.4 days to cover then). Sources: https://equibles.com/stocks/wolf/short-interest?range=3m and https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Wolfspeed+Stock+Short+Interest+Rises+to+51.81%25 (2026-10-29). A large share is probably convertible-arbitrage hedging: about 33M+ conversion shares sit across the 2L, Renesas 2L and 1.5L converts (S-3ASR, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/895419/000119312526393324/d106994ds3asr.htm), so not all of it covers on a print. The sealed 25-delta skew is -5.88 vol points, meaning calls are bid over puts ('upside paid'). Put/call open interest is 0.86. The stock is -31.5% over 20 days and -19.4% over 5 days, 70.8% off its 52-week high, and $21.49 is below the $23.33 average price target. Positioning leans toward a squeeze, not a further break.

findings.finding: Two named Wolfspeed automotive customers cut volume in WOLF's fiscal Q1 (Jul-Sep 2026). GM's US EV deliveries were 25,473 in calendar Q3 2026, against 30,828 in Q2 (-17% q/q) and 66,501 a year earlier (-62% y/y). Lucid built 2,954 vehicles against 4,774 in Q2 (-38% q/q, -24% y/y) after cutting an Arizona shift in June. The company guided Q1 revenue flat at $150M at the midpoint and the consensus sits there too.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue-miss prints have been punished: 2025-10-29 (Q1 FY26 revenue miss and weak outlook) -18.2%, 2026-02-04 (Q2 miss) -9.7%. In Q4 FY26 revenue was $149.6M against $150.0M consensus, with weaker auto offset by AI data center (+20% q/q), and the stock fell 9.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus is still at the guide midpoint ($149.86M), as it would not be if analysts had cut for customer build declines. The stock's October fall is attributed in the press to 'sector caution' (JKN, 2026-10-31) and not to these customer numbers. Partly priced through the -31% run-up. Wolfspeed ships ahead of builds, and management already flagged weak auto visibility on 2026-08-19, which limits the size.
findings.independence: Lucid Q3 2026 production 2,954 vs 4,774 in Q2: https://insideevs.com/news/810884/lucid-sales-production-q3-2026/ (2026-10-06). Both are proxies, because neither company discloses SiC purchases. Net of the rest of the company: AI data center revenue grew about 20% q/q in Q4 and Materials was $43.3M of $149.6M, so the auto share of revenue is well under the whole. A BorgWarner number points the other way (next finding).

findings.finding: BorgWarner, a Wolfspeed device customer with a 2022 capacity-corridor deal, reported Q3 2026 light-vehicle eProduct sales of $630M, +33% y/y, raised its full-year adjusted EPS guide to $5.20-5.35, and on 2026-10-29 signed a new multi-year agreement for Wolfspeed 1200V SiC devices for its 800V inverter platform.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Customer and supply agreements have not held: the stock fell 10.1% on 2026-10-30, the day after the BorgWarner agreement and BorgWarner's print (JKN, https://news.jkn.co.kr/editions/english/post/1060447). The one post-emergence up print (2026-05-05, +17.6%) came with a firmer outlook.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a counterparty print after Wolfspeed last spoke (08-19), and it is the opposite of the GM/Lucid read. The stock fell after it, so the market has not credited it. If it had, the October slide would not have accelerated on 10-30. The agreement has no disclosed value, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: Agreement detail: https://evertiq.com/design/2026-10-30-wolfspeed-announces-sic-device-supply-deal-with-borgwarner (2026-10-30). The BorgWarner release and the agreement are separate documents. Contradicted in direction by the GM/Lucid proxy above.

findings.finding: Large peers that reported after Wolfspeed's 08-19 call describe improving power-semiconductor demand. STMicro guided Q4 2026 revenue to $4.15B at the midpoint, +10.5% sequential and +24.7% y/y, on 'strong bookings and improving visibility', and its Power & Discrete segment grew 11.3% y/y, though that segment's operating loss widened to $81M. onsemi's Q3 revenue was $1,722M (+11% y/y), its Q4 guide is $1,715-1,815M, and it raised its AI data center 2030 target. In October WOLF fell 25%, ON 8% and STM 14%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No direct history on peer read-through. WOLF's own guide moves have been the swing factor: a weak outlook took it -18.2% in Oct 2025, a better outlook +17.6% in May 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: WOLF fell three times as much as onsemi in October, and its average price target ($23.33) sits above spot. If the peer demand recovery were in WOLF's price it would have tracked them, not diverged. The divergence may instead be WOLF-specific share loss to Chinese substrate makers, which keeps this small.
findings.independence: onsemi Q3 2026 8-K ex.99.1: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001097864/000114036126041580/ef20084671_ex99-1.htm (2026-11-02). These are two separate documents and both are peers, not WOLF customers. The October peer moves are from https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/30/wolfspeed-is-down-25-in-october-stay-the-course-or-just-stay-away/.

findings.finding: Short interest is 27.4M shares, 51.7% of shares outstanding (2026-10-15), and has risen every settlement since August. Calls are bid over puts (skew -5.88), and the stock is -31.5% over 20 days and -19.4% over 5 days into the print. A print that is not worse than the $140-160M / negative-gross-margin guide has a squeeze mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-05-05 +17.6% with short interest high. On 2026-10-07 a financing headline produced a +27% after-hours spike (Reuters via https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/08/wolfspeed-secures-15-billion-conditional-loan-commitment-from-us-defense-department), which shows how hard the stock moves on any positive surprise.
findings.why_not_priced: The options already price upside (negative skew), so part of this is in the price. What is not priced is the combination of a still-rising short with a 31% 20-day drawdown that has taken out most of the post-OSC spike. Much of the short is probably convert-arb hedging that does not cover on a print, which keeps the size modest.
findings.independence: Quiver Quant, 51.81% of float, 2026-10-29: https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Wolfspeed+Stock+Short+Interest+Rises+to+51.81%25. This is the same FINRA data, so it is not independent. The skew comes from the sealed baseline (Yahoo options), a different source.

findings.finding: The S-3ASR filed 2026-09-17 registers up to 58,148,889 shares for resale, more than the 52,995,396 shares outstanding. Renesas alone accounts for 32.9M (16.85M held, plus 11.1M on conversion and 4.94M warrant shares at $23.95). Renesas's board representative resigned effective 2026-09-27 and was replaced by an observer (8-K 2026-08-25). Any post-print rally meets registered supply from holders whose cost basis is a bankruptcy conversion.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No post-registration print yet. The stock has fallen from about $28 at the filing to $21.5 while short interest rose, consistent with hedged supply.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the shelf is public and the stock has slid since. What is not visible is any Renesas sale, since no 13D/13G amendment or Form 4 was found. The overhang caps a squeeze; it does not cause a fall on the print, so it is small.
findings.independence: 8-K item 5.02, Renesas director resigns to observer: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/895419/000089541926000057/wolfspeed-20260820.htm (2026-08-25). A separate document. Pulls against the squeeze finding above; both are filed because one is supply and the other is demand to cover.

findings.finding: The Department of War Office of Strategic Capital issued a conditional commitment (2026-10-07) for up to $1.5B of 30-year senior secured delayed-draw financing. Definitive agreements, approvals, appropriations and consents under existing debt are still outstanding, and warrants of up to 7.5% of fully diluted equity would be issued as tranches fund. The CFO had called refinancing the roughly $630M of ~16% first-lien debt the top priority (08-19 call). The call may give a definitive-agreement or refinancing update.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement drew +27% after hours on 10-07, then the stock round-tripped to below the pre-news level by 11-04.
findings.why_not_priced: The full round-trip of the +27% spike shows the market now assigns little probability to funding. A dated path to definitive agreements, or a cheaper refinancing of the 16% first-lien, would re-price it. On the financing question, the money buys long-dated capacity capital at government cost against 16% debt, with $1.09B of cash on hand, so this is not distress money. It is a positive or zero, minus the 7.5% warrant dilution.
findings.independence: 08-19 call: about $630M of first-lien at about 16% is the top refinancing priority, gross-margin breakeven at about $800M annual revenue run rate, https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262119459-tradingkey. A separate document.

findings.finding: Infineon and Wolfspeed signed a new multi-year 200mm SiC wafer supply agreement (2026-10-15), moving Infineon's supply from 150mm to 200mm substrates; Wolfspeed has closed its Durham 150mm device fab and its US production is now all 200mm. Materials was $43.3M of Q4 revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior supply-agreement headlines have not held into prints; the stock fell through October after this one.
findings.why_not_priced: No value or volume was disclosed, and Infineon describes itself as multi-sourcing. Management may quantify the agreement or the 150-to-200mm materials transition in the Q2 guide. It is two-sided because the 150mm volume to Infineon may fall during the transition.

findings.finding: Wolfspeed's AI data center revenue more than doubled in FY26 and grew about 20% sequentially in Q4 FY26. onsemi raised its AI data center 2030 revenue target on 2026-11-02, and STMicro and onsemi both name AI data center as their lead demand driver. This favours a mix that helps WOLF's gross margin against falling auto.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q4 FY26 the AI line grew 20% q/q and the stock still fell 9.4%, because the line is too small to move gross margin.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: management told the market this in August. The residual is the peer confirmation landing after WOLF spoke. Small.
findings.independence: onsemi 8-K 2026-11-02: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001097864/000114036126041580/ef20084671_ex99-1.htm. This shares the onsemi document with the peer finding above, so the size is kept small to avoid counting it twice.

FINRA's 2026-10-30 short-interest settlement is released on 2026-11-10; the model estimate is 27.8M (+1.5%).

Coherent SiC: no fiscal Q1 2027 results yet.
Full Q4 FY26 transcript Q&A: Benzinga returned 403; used the tradingkey summary.

baseline_tension: The skew (calls bid) and the crowded short lean up, and the -31% run-up means much bad news is already in the price. The name's own post-emergence history (3 of 4 prints down, median |move| 13.7) and the customer build declines cut against that, so the evidence nets to roughly balanced and p_up sits at 51.
lessons_applied: Lesson 9 (segment net of the rest): GM/Lucid auto proxy shrunk -1.0 to -0.7, because AI data center and Materials offset the auto share.
Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): BorgWarner finding shrunk +0.7 to +0.5, because the stock fell 10% the day after that news and 3 of 4 prints were sold.
Lesson 5 (proxy smaller): peer read-through shrunk +0.8 to +0.6, because STM's SiC-bearing P&D segment loss widened.
Lesson 5/7 (positioning is the information set; crowded short as a mechanism): short-squeeze finding shrunk +1.5 to +1.0, because much of the 52% short is probably convert-arb hedging.
Lesson 7: the overhang negative shrunk -0.7 to -0.6, given the crowded short.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): OSC finding kept at +0.5 after asking what the money buys (long-dated capacity capital against 16% debt, $1.09B cash, not distress).
p_up moved 52 to 51 (lessons 1 and 3: reaction history and own caveats toward 50); abs_move_pct unchanged at 14.
